title: Parsnip and lentil bake with crispy crumbs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain whole food or cupboard staple, such as lentils, tinned tomatoes, stock and breadcrumbs.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, puy lentils included, is an everyday item at Tesco.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, foil and an oven, with simple roasting and baking.

works.reason: 600ml stock plus a tin of tomatoes suits 200g puy lentils baked covered for 40 minutes, and the quantities are sensible for four.

honest_times.reason: The page was asked to be quick, but the steps add up to 75 minutes of cooking (20 + 40 + 15), so dinner takes an hour and a half, which a weeknight reader expecting a quick meal would not get.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming root-and-lentil bake suits late March, and the roasted parsnips are the centre of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Parsnips, lentils, tomatoes and kale make a filling, wholesome family dinner.
